column1: # Function names of the Ghidra program (ORAS_ENGINE.md 6), applied by ApplyNames.java: address, name, role, read|guess.
# "read": the code shows the role; "guess": named from context. Subsystem prefixes: Zone_ Map_ Event_ Field_ Script_ Res_ Mem_
# Gfx_ Snd_ Text_ Save_ Util_ Sys_. A module address is its linked one (cro_link.py: DllField at 0x10242000).
# Zone change (7 October): the 782 functions entering a zone runs that walking does not (coverage_map.py), read by sub-agents.
